slides.texte_overlay:
7 Powerful Habits That Will
Change How Others
Perceive You

1. Walk slower
Rushing looks anxious.
A steady pace looks
like control.

2. Put the phone away
in conversations
Full attention is rare.
People feel it.

3. Remember what
people tell you
Ask about it next time.
They won't forget you.

4. Give specific compliments
"Nice job" is noise.
"The way you handled that
client" is respect.

5. Don't complain in public
Everyone has problems.
The man who handles his
quietly stands out.

6. Ask better questions
Not "how's work?"
Ask "what are you
excited about lately?"

7. Learn something new
every day
Curious people are
interesting people.
slides.texte_sophia:
